name: Conqueror: Sparta
source:
235 BC. Sparta, once the mightiest state in all of Greece, now is just a shadow of its former self. 
However, as king Cleomenes III ascends to the throne, things are about to change once and for all...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240808225911/https://onyxian.itch.io/conqueror-sparta]Itch.io[/url]]
